definitions.gloss: senior Shinto priest; shrine priest (second rank)
definitions.explanation: A Shinto priesthood rank, second in the hierarchy below the chief priest. Responsible for assisting in shrine rituals and administration.

examples.japanese: {禰宜|ねぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{祝詞|のりと}→祝詞：30669_norito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奏上|そうじょう}→奏上：30670_soujou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The shrine priest recited a Shinto prayer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{禰宜|ねぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}めている→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: He serves as a senior priest at the local shrine.

examples.japanese: {禰宜|ねぎ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{宮司|ぐうじ}→宮司：12654_guuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{補佐|ほさ}→補佐：19834_hosa⟧し、⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{祭祀|さいし}や⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運営|うんえい}→運営：05096_unei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{携|たずさ}わる→携わる：09333_tazusawaru⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な⟦{役職|やくしょく}→役職：05514_yakushoku⟧だ。
examples.english: The negi is an important position that assists the chief priest and is involved in daily rituals and shrine management.

notes:
An ancient Shinto term. The word originally comes from ⟦{労|ねぎら}う→労う：15729_negirau⟧ (to console/comfort), reflecting the priest's role as an intermediary who comforts and serves the gods.

The Shinto priest hierarchy at most shrines is:
- ⟦{宮司|ぐうじ}→宮司：12654_guuji⟧: chief priest (head of the shrine)
- {禰宜|ねぎ}: senior priest (second rank)
- {権禰宜|ごんねぎ}: assistant priest (third rank)

Small shrines may have only a ⟦{宮司|ぐうじ}→宮司：12654_guuji⟧ and no {禰宜|ねぎ}, while large shrines like Ise Jingu may have many priests at each level. The word is also a common Japanese surname.

Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{葱|ねぎ}→葱：05189_negi⟧ (green onion).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {禰宜|ねぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as a negi
- {権禰宜|ごんねぎ}: assistant priest
- {禰宜|ねぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{装束|しょうぞく}→装束：14048_shouzoku⟧: priest's ceremonial garments
